lines.text: The Gibeonites refused silver and gold and asked David for seven of Saul's male descendants to hang at Gibeah.
David spared Mephibosheth son of Jonathan because of his oath, and the other seven died at the start of the wheat harvest.
Rizpah kept birds and beasts off the bodies, and David took the bones of Saul and Jonathan from Jabesh-gilead.
Saul and Jonathan's bones were buried in Zela in the tomb of Jesse, and God answered prayers for the land.
